metadata.description: Claude Code mods: panes and other interface drawn by the engine's hooks API

plugins.name: overview
plugins.description: A session overview pane: context, cost, time, turns, tools, files, subagents, limits and git; cells in the terminal, charts in the desktop app

plugins.name: issues
plugins.description: A pane listing the open GitHub issues of the session's repository

plugins.name: launcher
plugins.description: The project's dev servers from .claude/launch.json in a pane: start, stop and restart each, see which answer and read their output

plugins.name: lab
plugins.description: Experiments that probe what the rendering engine accepts: SVG, animation, interaction and every element, each in its own pane

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: An IDE-style file tree that shows what Claude reads, writes and commits, with git status and lines changed. Fork of data-goblin/claude-code-filetree (MIT)

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel. Fork of Anthropic's claude-code-playground (Apache-2.0)
